notes: a long report: four isnads for one description of the Prophet's appearance; the second to fourth routes repeat the matn, the first ends where the text says «إلى ها هنا»
the last link of each route is Hasan b. Ali, the one who says «سألت خالي», as the chain writes it; Hind b. Abi Hala speaks inside the matn but has no route of his own
«وكتمتها الحسين» and the questions about the Prophet's entry and assembly are the same chain, not separate isnads
Hasan b. Ali's name recurs in four routes; the occurrence numbers count the text's own occurrences of the words
